node: Broadline distributors and contracted restaurant procurement
summary: Expanded the universe around broadline foodservice distribution and contracted restaurant procurement. The two-lane structure separates obvious reference distributors, which define the node economics, from underfollowed restaurant operators and input suppliers where procurement dependency may create hidden margin risk or second-order upside. Strongest direct node anchors are Sysco and US Foods. More underfollowed discovery candidates are GEN Restaurant Group, because filings reportedly disclose a material Sysco agreement and prior US Foods concentration, and Lamb Weston, because restaurant chains appear operationally dependent on consistent frozen-potato supply even where relationships are not purely contractual.
